name: Golden Epic Poster
description: A hyper-detailed painterly poster look with monumental scale, layered distance, and a palette locked to gold, amber, bronze and deep crimson with cool shadow.
style_bible: Hyper-detailed painterly digital illustration built to read as a cinematic history poster. Medium and surface: painted, not photographed — a high-finish digital painting with the confident blended handling of concept art rather than the tooth of canvas, no visible impasto and no craquelure, every form carried by tone and edge control instead of texture. Detail contract: everything in the frame is sharp and finished, from the smallest near detail to the most distant form; nothing is left as a suggestion, and depth is made by haze and scale rather than by softening or by blur. Composition: one clear focal subject held at three-quarter length so the waist or the hip is the lower cut, set on one side of the frame and turned slightly inward toward the centre. Where the subject is a figure, its clothing, metal and cloth are painted honestly for its own world. Behind and around it, depth is arranged in receding bands — the scene's near plane, middle distance and distance — so a viewer reads whatever span the scene shows in one continuous sweep. Lighting: where the scene provides a low warm backlight, broad soft rays pass through the scene's own haze across the whole width of the frame, rimming the subject with a hot bronze edge and lifting warm bounce into the shadow side so nothing goes black. Palette: locked to gold, amber, bronze and deep crimson, with cool blue-grey and slate reserved for the shadow side and the deepest recesses, and no other hue permitted to take any real area of the frame. Atmosphere: where the scene has depth, volumetric haze layers it, the far distance dissolving into warm gold rather than into grey. Framing: sixteen by nine with the subject held to one side and the opposite upper quadrant deliberately kept quiet; where the scene has a horizon, keep it low and the upper third open, the eye line at or just above it. Mood: monumental, warm and settled, a whole world seen from a great distance rather than a moment of action inside it. Keep the contract content-independent: no fixed individual, dynasty, costume set, skyline, event, or copied composition.
negative_prompt: flat colour, flat vector, cel shading, anime, manga, comic ink, cartoon, caricature, chibi, sketch, unfinished background, photograph, photorealistic camera render, film still, HDR photo look, lens flare, bokeh, shallow depth of field, motion blur, muted grey palette, desaturated monochrome, pastel palette, neon, printed logos, two or more figures in the foreground, crowd pressed against the camera, face close to camera, action pose, raised objects, combat action, gore, readable lettering, captions, signatures, watermarks, frames, borders, UI elements, copied reference composition
